name: Andropolis
tagline: Classic city building: an open-source Android port of Micropolis (SimCity).
description:
Build and run a city. Zone land for homes, shops and industry, connect it with roads,
rail and power, balance the budget, and keep your citizens happy — while fires, floods,
tornadoes and the occasional monster try to spoil your plans.

Andropolis is an open-source Android port of Micropolis, the GPL release of the
original SimCity city simulator by Will Wright. It uses the MicropolisCore engine: the
original simulation code, in C++, unchanged.

Features

• The full classic simulation: zones, traffic, pollution, crime, land value, budget, evaluation

• The 8 original scenarios (Dullsville, San Francisco, Hamburg, Bern, Tokyo, Detroit, Boston, Rio) and 23 sample cities

• New maps with terrain choices: trees, lakes, rivers, islands

• Touch controls: drag roads and power lines, place buildings with a preview, per-build undo

• Overlays, graphs, messages, the citizens' opinion poll and the annual report

• Optional background play: the city keeps going while the app is closed, at a pace you choose, and notifies you when something happens

• Saves are plain files you can copy and share

• No ads, no tracking, no network access
